collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a healer or elder)

collection.description: An elder with stiff hands hears out a long, stinging treatment and says no, thank you: respect it, or ask what would help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s hands have grown stiff and knobbly over the years. (friend) explains a treatment carefully: a hot paste rubbed in twice a day, then exercises, squeezing a ball of clay. It might help. It might not. It will take weeks and the paste stings. (subject) listens to all of it, nods and says, "No, thank you."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Is there anything you would like?" asks (friend). (subject) thinks. "Somebody to open the jars," (subject.he/she) says. "That's all I want. The rest I can manage." So that's what happens. (friend) mentions it to a few people, and now somebody stops by most mornings to open (subject)'s jars. It isn't medicine. It's exactly what (subject.he/she) asked for.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) nods. "That's your choice. If you change your mind, the paste keeps." (subject) smiles. "My hands work well enough for what I like to do," (subject.he/she) says. "Holding a cup. Patting a dog. Pointing at people who are doing it wrong." (friend) laughs. (friend.He/she) does leave a smooth warm stone by (subject)'s door on cold mornings, and (subject) uses that, because nobody said anything about stones.
